runs.name: Verified order fulfillment
runs.summary: The agent proposes inventory reservation, payment capture, and fulfillment; the kernel authorizes each effect and assigns success only after three exact-state invariants pass.

runs.name: Lost payment response reconciled
runs.summary: Payment commits but its response is lost; after a durable restart the runtime reconciles the same operation without a duplicate charge, then verifies success.

runs.name: Payment declined after inventory reservation
runs.summary: The kernel records the failed charge, then releases inventory and cancels the order in reverse order before verifying the compensated state.

runs.name: Compensation cannot be verified
runs.summary: A failed inventory release cannot be proven safe, so the kernel stops the unwind and records a human-required escalation instead of guessing.
